title.zh: ESMA提出MiCA规则，涵盖DeFi网关、质押、借贷及不合规稳定币限制
title.en: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending

current_state.zh: ESMA提议终止对不合规稳定币的欧盟托管和转账服务，收紧对在欧盟运营的稳定币发行方和服务提供商的MiCA规则执行。
current_state.en: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.

updates.title_zh: ESMA 提议针对 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷的 MiCA 规则
updates.title_en: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA 提议的 MiCA 规则将要求 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷服务获得牌照，并禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的 MiCA 可许可服务。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA 提议的 MiCA 规则将要求 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷服务获得牌照，并禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的 MiCA 可许可服务。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.

updates.title_zh: ESMA 提议终止欧盟对不合规稳定币的托管和转账服务
updates.title_en: ESMA proposes ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA 2026年9月30日的MiCA审查回应进一步提议将不合规稳定币限制扩展至托管和转移服务，可能使现有持有者在交易对下架后失去持牌托管人的服务渠道。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA's September 30, 2026 MiCA review response further proposes extending non-compliant stablecoin restrictions to custody and transfer services, potentially removing licensed-custodian access for existing holders after trading pairs are delisted.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA提议的MiCA规则要求DeFi网关、质押和借贷服务获得许可，禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的MiCA可许可服务，并进一步提议将限制扩展至不合规稳定币的托管和转移服务。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules requiring licensing for DeFi gateways, staking and lending services, barring crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving non-compliant stablecoins, and further proposing to extend restrictions to custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA has proposed extending MiCA restrictions on non-compliant stablecoins to custody and transfer services, which would strip EU holders of licensed-custodian access to those tokens once their trading pairs are removed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA has proposed extending MiCA restrictions on non-compliant stablecoins to custody and transfer services, which would strip EU holders of licensed-custodian access to those tokens once their trading pairs are removed.
